hypothesis: Doubling only the 20 Td measurement window to 6.4 microseconds resolves the marginal half-window stationarity failure while preserving the modern ETHZ experimental pass under unchanged acceptance thresholds.
prior_information: The locked three-field run passed every experimental and precision gate, but its 20 Td half-window drift change was 6.22% against a 5% limit. The earlier independent 20 Td numerical study also identified low signal-to-noise rather than a monotonic energy transient. This extension was locked after observing that failure.
inheritance: If the isolated 20 Td run passes all declared gates, combine it with the unchanged passing 10 and 30 Td points from the parent run to classify the three-field modern ETHZ milestone as complete. The parent 20 Td estimate is superseded only for stationarity completion and is not averaged with this run.
claim_boundary: This is an explicitly disclosed post-failure measurement-window extension, not an independent replication. No tolerance, collision physics, field, seed, timestep, particle count, or burn horizon changes. All parent-rule scientific limitations remain.
